title: Lab accessible content page
description: Combine document structure, metadata, landmarks, headings, lists, links and responsive images into a responsive accessible handbook without JavaScript or a backend.
objectives: Build a complete standalone HTML page from the eight module topics
Provide semantic landmarks, keyboard navigation and readable headings
Add responsive imagery with meaningful alternatives and layout-safe dimensions
Verify local assets and responsive behavior in Chromium, not just text assertions
rubric: I completed a coherent standalone page containing all document-structure topics.
I tested keyboard focus, skip-link behavior and image loading at desktop and mobile widths.
I passed local structural tests and understood the separate browser verification boundary.
